note: Allocation list of the official add-on directory (propwashfpv.com/addons/): append only. A namespace and its short id are never given again; an add-on that leaves the directory stays with status withdrawn. Short id 1 is Propwash itself.

text.en: Many more realistic parts for Propwash, from 65 mm whoops to 13″ X-Class: frames in new shapes (stretched, squashed, deadcat, H-frame, ducts), motors, props, stacks, cameras and batteries, plus ready-to-fly presets.
text.de: Viele weitere realistische Teile für Propwash, vom 65-mm-Whoop bis zur 13-Zoll-X-Class: Rahmen in neuen Formen (Stretched, Squashed, Deadcat, H-Frame, Ducts), Motoren, Props, Stacks, Kameras und Akkus, dazu flugfertige Presets.
